summary_en: This study tests combinations of olutasidenib with other drugs, such as cladribine, cytarabine, venetoclax, gilteritinib, or ruxolitinib, in adults with relapsed or refractory IDH1-mutated myeloid malignancies that have a co-signaling mutation. Olutasidenib is taken by mouth, and the other drugs are given by mouth, by IV, or under the skin, depending on the arm; how long or how often is not stated. The study measures safety and tolerability, and this is a Phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba combinaciones de olutasidenib con otros medicamentos, como cladribina, citarabina, venetoclax, gilteritinib o ruxolitinib, en adultos con neoplasias mieloides recaídas o refractarias con mutación IDH1 que tienen una mutación de señalización asociada. Olutasidenib se toma por vía oral, y los otros medicamentos se administran por vía oral, intravenosa o subcutánea, según el grupo; la duración o la frecuencia no están indicadas. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y es un ensayo de fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with relapsed or refractory AML, or high-risk MDS, MPN, or MDS/MPN with at least 10% blasts.
Documented co-signaling mutation in genes such as KRAS, NRAS, PTPN11, FLT3, KIT, JAK2, or CALR.
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower.
Adequate kidney and liver function, and able to sign informed consent.
not_for: Acute promyelocytic leukemia or translocation t(15;17).
Active, uncontrolled leukemia in the central nervous system.
New York Heart Association class III or IV heart condition.
White blood cell count above 25 x 10^9/L, or pregnancy, breastfeeding, or no adequate contraception.
